_meta.type: build -- fixes the two defects found in v0
carried_forward_from_v0_unchanged: score = relative volume, 10-min trailing, causal, E2's 3-session baseline B_e
gate 2 = highest score among candidates live at that moment; liveness = the gate's own window close
trade = the gate's real trade: first-window rising-edge entry, window-close exit, realized hold
diagnostic = Spearman(score, move_at), alongside, gating nothing

fix1_causal_gate1.rule: at each candidate moment, threshold = the 75th percentile of every candidate score observed STRICTLY BEFORE that moment, pooled across tickers, updated chronologically
fix1_causal_gate1.warmup_behaviour: below 250 prior observations every candidate passes gate 1 and is flagged gate1_warmup
fix1_causal_gate1.min_prior_observations_note: 250 is a round a-priori choice, not fitted. The warmup share per policy is reported.
fix1_causal_gate1.why: v0's threshold was the 75th percentile over the whole backtest sample, which is not computable at decision time. Nothing in this rule depends on data from after the trade it gates.

fix2_population_gap_gate_on.method: faithful post-hoc reconstruction of the runner's own gap-gate logic from the run's per-trade record plus the tick archive -- NOT a re-run
fix2_population_gap_gate_on.why_not_a_rerun: scanner-epg-momentum is read-only per CLAUDE.md and its val_full run took 20,713 s. The gap gate is a deterministic function of the tick stream inside each PASS window, and every PASS window's bounds are on record in per_trade.parquet, so it can be reconstructed exactly.

runner_semantics_reproduced.on_rising_edge: if intraday_pct >= threshold -> immediate entry; else -> queued wait
runner_semantics_reproduced.queued: while the window stays PASS, re-check on every tick; first tick meeting the threshold enters (queued entry)
runner_semantics_reproduced.blocked: window closes before the threshold is met
runner_semantics_reproduced.fill_convention: the condition is tested on price[i]; the fill is price[i+1], the NEXT tick. Reproduced.
runner_semantics_reproduced.entry_ts_convention: entry_ts is ts[i], the trigger tick, not the fill tick. Reproduced.
runner_semantics_reproduced.validated: 6/6 spot checks reproduce the existing run's entry_price exactly from px[i+1]

fix2_population_gap_gate_on.threshold_measure_primary: move_at = (price - tick-derived prior close) / prior close
fix2_population_gap_gate_on.threshold_measure_primary_why: D4 (tick-derived only) and v0's first non-negotiable (move_at, never a non-causal or non-tick measure). v0-T4 measured the gate's own intraday_pct_at_entry against move_at at Spearman 0.314 -- they are not the same condition, and only one of the gate's three prev-close sources is tick-derived.
fix2_population_gap_gate_on.threshold_measure_secondary: the gate's own intraday_pct_at_entry >= 0.30, reported as a variant
fix2_population_gap_gate_on.first_window_rule: the earliest PASS window that produces an entry under the reconstructed gap gate

candidate_moment_proxy.rule: the first minute bar whose high >= prior_close * 1.30 -- the first moment the +30% crossing is observable
candidate_moment_proxy.source: event_minute_bars_v2 (Phase 6b tick aggregate; D5 A11 -- reuse needs no citation)
candidate_moment_proxy.why_a_proxy: the gate's own first rising edge does not exist for D1. R0-T0b established the gate has never been run on 93% of D1 and on no event before 2023-11-17. The +30% crossing is the program's own momentum definition, is causal, and is computable for all of D1.
candidate_moment_proxy.d4: minute bars are tick-derived; prior close is tick-derived. No spine numeric enters.

fix3_d1_concurrency.liveness_sweep_note: declared a priori, all reported side by side, never selected from. 9 minutes is the empirical median first-window duration measured in v0 (540 s) and is the closest available stand-in for the gate's own window-close definition, which does not exist for D1. 'no cap' (live to session end) is reported as a fifth.

fix4_price_level.rule: net markout by detection-price decile, independent of the gate policy table
fix4_price_level.source_note: E1's reconstruction of F1-T6's D4-compliant tick-derived detection price and decile for all 20,951 events. Reused, not re-derived.
fix4_price_level.why: Phase 11 established net edge as a function of detection-price level. Reported separately so a price-driven effect is not misread as a gate effect.

score.name: relative_volume
score.formula: dollar volume of all prints in [tau - W, tau] divided by B_e
score.tau: the v1 entry trigger instant (ts[i]), not the fill instant
score.baseline_status: UNCOMMITTED on explore/fundamental-e1 and still uncommitted. The score is not reproducible from a clean checkout until it lands.
score.baseline_definition: mean dollar volume per 10-minute RTH block over n_baseline_sessions prior sessions (total/B_e = n_sessions x 39, verified in v0-T0)

gate_2.rule: score is the highest among all candidates whose window is concurrently live at that moment
gate_2.liveness: [entry trigger ts, natural_exit_ts] of each candidate's own selected window

evaluation.exit_primary: window close (natural_exit_ts / natural_exit_price of the selected window)

cost.choice: Phase 11's stack. The gate has NO native fill or cost model -- config/strategy.json carries epg, hawkes, exit_d, luld and gap_gate blocks and no fee block, and pnl is a pure price ratio. Verified in v0-T3.

constraints.d4: tick-derived only; no spine numeric column enters any computed quantity
